name: Instrument: bell strings (restring)
notes: Your guitar restrung an octave up as very stiff strings: their harmonics are pushed sharp (400 cents at the 10th), so notes ring like bells or a toy piano, for 8 s. Physics: the stiff string (restring). Guesses: the final eq. Not physics: the pitch tracker (20-30 ms after the pick). Stiffness at 0 gives plain strings; around 20-50 a piano's.
